# LuxBath Charlotte

> LuxBath Charlotte (LuxBath Charlotte LLC) is a luxury bathroom remodeling company in Charlotte, North Carolina, founded by Eugeniu. It specializes in high-end, European-style bathrooms (custom walk-in showers, full-tile bathrooms, floating vanities, integrated LED lighting) built on complete Schluter and Wedi waterproofing systems. It also builds kitchens, custom built-in cabinetry and flooring.

## Key facts
- Founder: Eugeniu
- Experience: 17+ years of professional remodeling
- Service area: Charlotte, Ballantyne, Matthews, Mint Hill, Indian Trail, Weddington, Waxhaw (North Carolina)
- Pricing: luxury bathrooms start from $18,000; every project is custom-priced on design, layout and materials
- Estimates: free in-home design consultation and written estimate, no obligation
- Rating: 5.0 on Google
- Insurance: fully insured
- Studio: 12579 Forager Place, Midland, NC 28107
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, Saturday 10am to 3pm, closed Sunday
- Email: luxbathclt@gmail.com
- Website: https://luxbathclt.com/

## Services
- **Luxury bathroom remodeling**: Complete bathroom transformations from layout to final fixture, custom-designed for each home.
- **Custom walk-in showers**: Curbless and low-threshold walk-in showers with frameless glass, linear drains, built-in niches and benches.
- **Full-tile bathrooms**: Floor-to-ceiling tile installation with large-format porcelain, mitered edges and aligned grout lines.
- **Integrated LED lighting**: Backlit mirrors, lit shower niches and under-vanity toe-kick lighting.
- **European-style bathroom design**: Floating vanities, wall-hung toilets with in-wall carriers and freestanding soaking tubs.
- **Schluter and Wedi shower waterproofing**: Complete Schluter and Wedi waterproofing systems installed on every wet wall and floor before tile.
- **Kitchen remodeling**: Custom cabinetry, quartz waterfall islands, tile backsplashes and lighting.
- **Built-in cabinetry**: Walk-in closets, pantries, media walls, wet bars and fireplace surrounds.
- **Flooring installation**: Hardwood, wide-plank and tile flooring with clean transitions and new trim.

## Frequently asked questions
### How much does a luxury bathroom remodel cost?
Our bathrooms start from $18,000. Your final price depends on the size of the room, the layout and the materials you choose. After a free consultation we give you a clear, written estimate, with no surprises.

### Do you only do bathrooms?
Bathrooms are our specialty and the heart of what we do. We also design and build kitchens, custom built-in cabinetry and flooring, often as part of a larger renovation, with the same eye for detail and the same clean, professional process.

### Why does waterproofing matter so much?
Water getting behind tile is what ruins most bathrooms. We install complete Schluter or Wedi systems, so walls and floors are sealed before a single tile goes up, protecting your home for the long term.

### Can you help with design and selections?
Absolutely. Every project is custom-designed. We'll guide you through layout, tile, fixtures, vanities and lighting so the finished room reflects your style and works the way you live.

### Which areas do you serve?
Charlotte, NC and the surrounding communities, including Ballantyne, Matthews, Mint Hill, Indian Trail, Weddington and Waxhaw.

### Are you insured?
Yes, LuxBath Charlotte is fully insured, and we bring more than 17 years of professional remodeling experience to every project.

### Do you offer free estimates?
Yes. Your in-home design consultation and written estimate are free, with no obligation. Request one through our contact form and we'll reply within one business day.

### What waterproofing systems do you use?
We use complete Schluter and Wedi waterproofing systems: waterproof wall boards, sealed seams and corners, properly sloped shower pans and uncoupling membranes under tile. It's our standard on every project, never an upgrade.
